description: Closed with no further action although the record shows 2,996,202.30 of credits and 3,446,939.33 of debits in 90 days against expected monthly credits of up to 833, 572,742.09 of cross-border outflows and an unexplained funding gap of 450,737.03. On this record, suspicion should have been formed and disclosed.
remediation: Reopen the case and make a prompt internal disclosure to the MLRO; coaching on assessing activity against the customer profile; sample-check the investigator's next five cases.

description: Material red flags not identified: activity far above the profile, 230 credits (2,981,759.88) concentrated in one 30-day block, debits to 50 receivers, cross-border outflows including watchlist locations, and prior TM04 and TM05 alerts. Only the alert trigger was considered.
remediation: Coaching: analyse the whole account (incoming and outgoing flows), not only the triggering activity.

description: Source of funds asserted as pension and savings with no supporting evidence; an assumption about missing information was recorded as if it were a finding.
remediation: Record source of funds as unresolved when it is not evidenced, and treat an unresolved source of funds as a factor in the disposition.

description: Screening recorded as clear although no screening results exist; the PEP and adverse-media values are KYC flags on file, not screening outcomes.
remediation: Never record screening as clear without evidence; use the standard wording for unavailable results.

description: The rationale does not state the grounds for suspicion or weigh the evidence. The outcome (disclosure) is supported by the record, but the note gives the MLRO nothing to assess.
remediation: Coaching on articulating the grounds for suspicion (what, who, why) in line with good SAR practice.

description: Red flags are generic and not tied to evidence: no figures, counterparties, jurisdictions or prior alerts.
remediation: Tie every red flag to a specific fact and figure.

description: Source of funds and source of wealth not assessed despite activity far above the profile (credits of 2,996,202.30 against expected monthly credits of up to 833).
remediation: Assess source of funds and wealth whenever activity is inconsistent with the profile.

description: Available earlier history (2022-10-07 to 2022-11-16) not reviewed despite the self-identified funding gap of 450,737.03 and a prior TM05 alert at the lookback boundary; the gap is documented and routed for follow-up.
remediation: Review available history before closure when it could materially affect the assessment, or justify why not.

description: No screening results exist in the simulation dataset. The note records this correctly and does not treat screening as clear, so this is a data limitation, not an investigator error.
remediation: None for the investigator; screening data would be needed for a real review.
